intro: Experience the best of both worlds the Ultima Plus. Designed for deep, restful sleep, it blends plush memory foam comfort with firm spinal support—so you wake up refreshed, every morning.

features.title: Memory foam that adapts to you
features.text: Experience ultimate comfort as the premium memory foam top layer adapts to your body shape, offering pressure relief and tailored support for a restful night.

features.title: Plush quilted surface for added cosiness
features.text: The 5mm quilt foam provides a soft, cushioned feel with a luxurious aesthetic, ensuring your sleep space looks and feels premium.

features.title: Breathable lavender fabric for a soothing sleep
features.text: Stay cool and comfortable with the 240 GSM lavender premium knitted fabric, offering a soothing texture and enhanced airflow for uninterrupted sleep.

features.title: Perfect fit for any bed frame
features.text: Designed to complement standard bed sizes, Ultima Plus seamlessly integrates into any bedroom while offering long-lasting durability.

name: Ultima Plus Double Bed Foam Mattress 78 X 48 X 5 Inches
